name: Jarvis 39.0
notes: 📊 Charts now always match the Excel result: Stacked charts never add Target + Achievement or last year + this year (shown side by side). Percentages, growth / degrowth and averages are never shown as pie / doughnut / waterfall slices or a fake Total, and are not added into an Others bar. Trend / Year-on-year / Growth charts of a result use only that result. Dealer GOLY / GOLM and Performance Ranking (growth, degrowth, achievement %) results now appear on the Charts page. Nothing else changes – the lock, unlock keys and access days work as before.
